verdict.rationale: Remote documents API sync that can 'pull workforce and payroll data out to your systems', plus a CLI whose list commands export to CSV or JSON, which an agent could consume. Nothing specifically describes payroll journal or general-ledger entries, or any reconciliation or ledger integration. missing for 10: a documented payroll journal/GL export endpoint or report, documented ledger or accounting-system reconciliation, agent-specific payroll-journal tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger

citations.quote: pull workforce and payroll data out to your systems — sync goes both ways.
Every list command exports to CSV with `-o csv`, and every command can emit JSON, so the output drops straight into spreadsheets and scripts.
The plugin works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
